antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 670nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in astrocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2024) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Mid-infrared 8.3um: water channel modulation at 36 THz, pulsed 10^-12s, 10min cycles targeting cytochrome_c in astrocyte. Study reference: 2024 peer-reviewed paper shows electron transport +12% at 670nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial complex_I_NADH activation.
